stage_notes.B1: per-module requirements; not a full durability proof
stage_notes.B2: K0-K5 + XADB-032: real rows, transaction/WAL/recovery/concurrency/checkpoint; no SQL/network dependencies
stage_notes.B3: DEV5 server: Q1 embedded SQL + C1 transport; real DISK, does not require PART/NG
stage_notes.VERSION_RELEASE: customer-delivery qualification only; compare all earlier same-major stable-release baselines, excluding all internal distributions. Before first declared stable release: NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_RELEASE_BASELINE. Internal builds use fresh DB/fixtures and still require current-build recovery/atomicity tests.
stage_notes.AI_PILOT: kernel tasks can start after B2; SQL/version/performance tasks require their feature baselines and additional gates
stage_notes.D0: initial architecture readiness only: stable IDs, snapshot storage boundaries, scope/media separation, shared commit extensibility and version contracts; not real disk/index proof
stage_notes.GLOBAL_INDEX_QUALIFICATION: follow-up actual mixed SQL/storage/recovery qualification; internal builds do not require cross-version conversion. Customer delivery additionally requires applicable VERSION_RELEASE cases.
stage_notes.PRODUCT_QUALIFIED: Internal product qualification: frozen exact baseline, complete leaf inventory, zero gaps/unresolved items, CLIENT1/SQL_EXT1/OPS1/P1 and required feature integrations. VERSION_RELEASE is added only by EXTERNAL_RELEASE for customer delivery.
stage_notes.F1: DEV1 shared semantics/effects and independently buildable core boundaries
stage_notes.S1: DEV3 bounded real DISK row/index/catalog API, common durability and capacity checks; no parser/server/global dependency
stage_notes.Q1: DEV4 minimal embedded SQL, both declared media; no network server
stage_notes.C1: COMM framed transport and local connections, independent of storage
stage_notes.P1: PART typed partition/local index/membership/lifecycle with production storage; no SQL/global prerequisite
stage_notes.CLIENT1: Current-build native/JDBC/ODBC support matrix. Cross-version old-client/new-server belongs only to customer-delivery VERSION_RELEASE.
stage_notes.H2: native global core on H1/P1; SQL-free API tests; does not wait for B3
stage_notes.H3: NG core lifetime/row move/capacity; full SQL integration remains GLOBAL_INDEX_QUALIFICATION
stage_notes.SQL_EXT1: All DEV7 required work packages and frozen variants pass; exact task dependencies add client/storage prerequisites per feature. Partial feature qualification does not close DEV7.
stage_notes.OPS1: All DEV8 replication/restore/operations/workload obligations and pre-registered numerical thresholds pass; unknown SLO or environment blocks closure.
